notes: Hand-written fixtures for evaluation/scorer.py. Every expected value was written by hand.
Patches follow RFC 7386 merge-patch rules for objects, except that a null sets the member to null; no fixture removes a member.

Before a fixture's patches apply, the builder sets S alert_id, S run_id and S severity.rule_floor from the case, H pass_id, position, case_id, role, repeat, backend and run_id from the order and S, and every A gen_ai.conversation.id to the run ID.

Each fixture's run is at position 2 of a fixture-mode order (k = 2) whose rounds start with the fixture's case; position 1 is the fx-dev1 warm-up. A second run (key second) is the same case's round-2 run at position 10.
Base outcome per case (floor = rule level, value high, origin model): fx-a1 under; fx-a2 over by model; fx-a3 agreement; fx-b1 over by model.

The registry holds two O-S twins: the severity objective is checked once with a target equal to the floor (fx-c3) and once with a target of high above the floor (fx-c1), and one twin cannot hold both.
